authority: Existing RC10 implementation plan: Production-like baseline / revised delivery comparison, 2026-10-01
initial_behavior: One transport attempt. Both orchestration arms start with these same bytes; the delivery task is to implement the specified bounded retry behavior.
requirements: A read-only request with established idempotency may retry transient TIMEOUT up to the finite maximumAttempts, counting the initial attempt.
A state-changing request without idempotency evidence executes once.
A NON_RETRYABLE failure executes once and preserves its category.
Preserve successful result and failure category; no real network or production writes.
comparison_boundary: Initial oracle failure verifies the task is unfinished. It is not a measured baseline arm, failed engineering delivery, or weaker source access. Actual baseline/revised runs need identical fixture bytes, governed r1 method access, real worker/review/readback receipts, and matched timing boundaries.
method_access: Both arms require the same eligible r1 source through the existing governed provider; no approval or authority is granted by this fixture.
